symptom: The rebuilt backend process started, but Compose marked it unhealthy and withheld frontend startup.
evidence: Bounded startup logs showed only the root route while Compose requested /api/health.

root_cause.summary: The restored backend omitted the health route required by the preserved Compose contract.

actions: Added GET /api/health using the normalized success envelope.
Rebuilt the backend image and recreated the stack.
Verified healthy containers and direct/proxied HTTP 200 responses.
reusable_resolution: Keep the backend /api/health route aligned with the Compose healthcheck before dependent-service startup.
prevention: Validate health-route compatibility when creating or updating the sanitized source baseline.
